name: Thief
fantasy: The cutpurse. Slips behind you, marks you, cashes in, gone in smoke.

card.loop: Shots and hits from behind stack Marks on a target; at 3 your Knife is ready and Cashes In.
card.dash: Two quick steps; after the last, your next hit counts as from behind.
card.passive: Hits from behind Mark the target (up to 3); 3 Marks = Knife ready, Cash In.
card.rmb: Throw a knife (1 Mark); recast to Shadow Step behind them.
card.e: A smoke cloud that hides you; knives from inside are silent.
card.r: Blink-strike up to 4 hunters in a row: 14 damage and 3 Marks each.

weapons.twin_blades: 3-hit combo; hold for a spin. Crits after a Shadow Step.
weapons.smg: Hold to spray; zero spread after a Shadow Step.

passive.name: Marks
passive.desc: Hits from behind (or in the Ambush window) Mark the target: up to 3, 6s, +5% damage from you each. At 3 the Knife is ready at once, and your next Knife on them Cashes In: a 26-damage gold payoff and your dash charge back.

dash.name: Flicker
dash.desc: Tap twice: two quick 2.3m steps on one charge (the second any way you like within 0.7s). Shots pass through each step. After the last step your next hit counts as from behind (Ambush, 1s).

variants.tap: Throw a knife 9m: 10 damage and a Mark. Recast within 1.5s of a hit to Shadow Step behind them (Ambush).
variants.hold: Fan: 3 knives in a 35° fan, 6m, 6 damage, slow, a Mark each.
variants.air: Drop Knife: the Shadow Step recast becomes a dive, a 1.5m burst for 8 behind them.
variants.during_e: Inside your smoke the knife is silent and its streak hidden.
variants.full: Cash In: a target at 3 Marks takes a 26-damage payoff and refunds your dash.

e.name: Smoke Veil
e.desc: A 3.5m cloud at the cursor (up to 6m) for 5s: everyone inside is hidden from outside, like tall grass. Attacking reveals you for 0.5s. Foes inside are slowed.

r.name: Heist
r.desc: A 0.4s fuse, then gold lines mark up to 4 rival hunters within 9m (0.3s, anyone who dashes out or breaks sight drops out), then four blink strikes 0.2s apart: 14 damage and 3 Marks each. You end behind the last with Ambush open.

rank2.ult: Rank 2 (level 9): cooldown 105s -> 89.2s, +30% duration, +15% damage; a 5th target, +15% damage.

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 8s -> 6.4s, damage +30%; Shadow Step recast window 1.5 -> 2.0s.

tells.full: gold purse glyph and a coin jingle on a 3-Mark target
tells.dash_spent: two smoke afterimages, dash pips dark
